name: g2-fpm-8134-minfpm
status: offsets derived from the built non PIE FPM binary; G2 not run live
md5_lock: select this profile only when the target binary md5 matches; a mismatch invalidates every offset

ps_serializers.note: the default php decode slot is not 16 byte aligned; with session.serialize_handler=php, target ps_serializer_slot and point it at a fake ps_serializer struct in the record

ps_serializer_slot.note: write the fake ps_serializer struct address here; the fake struct is 24 bytes, name at +0, encode at +8, decode at +0x10

decode_call.note: the decode pointer is read from PS(serializer) on every decode, so the write is consumed by the forced END update in the same request

record.x_mapping: file byte i maps to ZSTR_VAL + i; ZSTR_VAL = X + 24
record.command_rule: the 0x20 key length byte is the leading space of the shell command; the command is padded to 32 bytes and must end in # so the value text is commented out

lab_geometry.note: record length from the 8.5.10 receipt; X, P and B0 are operator supplied and are not part of this profile

libc.note: lab glibc build only; system is not imported by php-fpm, so a libc base leak is required; popen takes a second argument the decode call site does not control

heap_leak.note: no ASLR capable heap leak demonstrated; the static session file route is attempted-negative (save path control and static serving proven, M11 overread failed, no pointer or B0); the G2 plan needs operator supplied X, P and B0

prerequisites: md5 locked: the target binary must match this profile md5
non PIE ET_EXEC binary with image base 0x400000
libc base for system (offset 0x53090), or a fixed call target; system is not imported
heap addresses X, P and B0 and the exact record length
upload progress enabled with the forced END update in the same request
the plant request must be the immediately preceding request on the same worker
single shot per plant: RINIT resets BG(unserialize), and the corrupted decode pointer persists until worker restart
with session.serialize_handler=php, target ps_serializer_slot and point it at a fake ps_serializer struct; the php decode slot is not 16 byte aligned
caveats: offsets are from a locally built non PIE FPM binary; this build was not run live
a binary md5 mismatch invalidates every offset
the default php serializer decode slot is not 16 byte aligned; the PS(serializer) pointer slot plus a fake ps_serializer struct is the target for that handler
zend_eval_string is not a valid decode target: rsi is ZSTR_LEN and zend_eval_stringl treats a non NULL retval_ptr as a zval and does ZVAL_COPY_VALUE, a wild write for a nonzero length

5.x cannot reuse this geometry: php_unserialize_data is {first, last, first_dtor, last_dtor}, dtor entries use zval *data[1024] with used_slots at +0x2000 and next at +0x2008, the bound is equality, and BG(unserialize) is a struct not a pointer
no claim is made for other session savers, opcache, ZTS or shared pools
